//! Postgres access for the operations designed on this service. Generated by Tessery.
//! Rows come back as JSON built by Postgres, and every value goes in as text with a cast to the column's type, so
//! Postgres does all type conversion.
#![allow(dead_code)]

use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::sync::OnceLock;
use std::time::Duration;

use deadpool_postgres::{Manager, Pool};
use serde_json::{Value, json};
use tokio_postgres::NoTls;
use tokio_postgres::types::ToSql;

/// A status code and a JSON body ready to send; no body means no content.
pub struct Reply {
    pub status: u16,
    pub body: Option<String>,
}

static POOL: OnceLock<Pool> = OnceLock::new();
const MIGRATION_LOCK: i64 = 727274;

fn pool() -> &'static Pool {
    POOL.get().expect("db::open was not called")
}

enum Fail {
    NotReady(String),
    Migration(String),
}

/// Connects to the postgres:// address and applies each migration that has not run yet, in order. Replicas wait on a
/// lock.
pub async fn open(address: &str, migrations: &[(&str, &str)]) {
    let config: tokio_postgres::Config = address.parse().expect("the database address is not a postgres:// URL");
    let pool = Pool::builder(Manager::new(config, NoTls)).max_size(10).build().expect("database pool");
    let _ = POOL.set(pool);
    let mut attempt = 1;
    loop {
        match migrate(migrations).await {
            Ok(()) => return,
            Err(Fail::Migration(e)) => panic!("{e}"),
            Err(Fail::NotReady(e)) if attempt < 30 => {
                tracing::info!(error = %e, "database not ready, retrying in 2s");
                tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_secs(2)).await;
                attempt += 1;
            }
            Err(Fail::NotReady(e)) => panic!("migrating: {e}"),
        }
    }
}

fn message(e: &tokio_postgres::Error) -> String {
    e.as_db_error().map(|d| d.message().to_owned()).unwrap_or_else(|| e.to_string())
}

async fn migrate(migrations: &[(&str, &str)]) -> Result<(), Fail> {
    let not_ready = |e: tokio_postgres::Error| Fail::NotReady(message(&e));
    let mut client = pool().get().await.map_err(|e| Fail::NotReady(e.to_string()))?;
    client.batch_execute(&format!("SELECT pg_advisory_lock({MIGRATION_LOCK})")).await.map_err(not_ready)?;
    let applied = apply(&mut client, migrations).await;
    let _ = client.batch_execute(&format!("SELECT pg_advisory_unlock({MIGRATION_LOCK})")).await;
    applied
}

async fn apply(client: &mut deadpool_postgres::Client, migrations: &[(&str, &str)]) -> Result<(), Fail> {
    let not_ready = |e: tokio_postgres::Error| Fail::NotReady(message(&e));
    client
        .batch_execute("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS _tessery_migrations (name text PRIMARY KEY, applied_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now())")
        .await
        .map_err(not_ready)?;
    for &(name, sql) in migrations {
        let seen = client.query_one("SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM _tessery_migrations WHERE name = $1)", &[&name]).await.map_err(not_ready)?;
        if seen.get::<_, bool>(0) {
            continue;
        }
        let failed = |e: tokio_postgres::Error| Fail::Migration(format!("migration {name} failed: {}", message(&e)));
        let tx = client.transaction().await.map_err(not_ready)?;
        tx.batch_execute(sql).await.map_err(failed)?;
        tx.execute("INSERT INTO _tessery_migrations (name) VALUES ($1)", &[&name]).await.map_err(failed)?;
        tx.commit().await.map_err(failed)?;
        tracing::info!(%name, "applied migration");
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub fn error(status: u16, body: Value) -> Reply {
    Reply { status, body: Some(body.to_string()) }
}

fn not_found() -> Reply {
    error(404, json!({ "error": "not_found" }))
}

fn rejected(e: tokio_postgres::Error) -> Reply {
    let Some(db) = e.as_db_error() else {
        tracing::warn!(error = %e, "database error");
        return error(500, json!({ "error": "internal" }));
    };
    let code = db.code().code();
    if code == "23502" {
        if let Some(col) = db.column() {
            return error(400, json!({ "error": "invalid", "field": col, "detail": format!("{col} is required") }));
        }
    }
    if code == "23505" {
        return error(409, json!({ "error": "already_exists", "detail": db.detail().unwrap_or("") }));
    }
    if code == "23503" {
        return error(409, json!({ "error": "reference_not_found", "detail": db.detail().unwrap_or("") }));
    }
    if code.starts_with("22") || code.starts_with("23") || code == "42703" {
        return error(400, json!({ "error": "invalid", "detail": db.message() }));
    }
    tracing::warn!(error = %e, "database error");
    error(500, json!({ "error": "internal" }))
}

fn quote(name: &str) -> String {
    format!("\"{}\"", name.replace('"', "\"\""))
}

fn snake(k: &str) -> String {
    let mut out = String::new();
    let mut prev_lower = false;
    for c in k.chars() {
        if c.is_ascii_uppercase() && prev_lower {
            out.push('_');
        }
        prev_lower = c.is_ascii_lowercase() || c.is_ascii_digit();
        out.push(c.to_ascii_lowercase());
    }
    out
}

fn text(v: &Value) -> Option<String> {
    match v {
        Value::Null => None,
        Value::String(s) => Some(s.clone()),
        other => Some(other.to_string()),
    }
}

/// Query keys a list understands besides column names.
const RESERVED: &[&str] = &["limit", "offset", "page", "q", "sort"];

fn text_type(t: &str) -> bool {
    t == "text" || t == "citext" || t.starts_with("varchar") || t.starts_with("character")
}

fn like(s: &str) -> String {
    format!("%{}%", s.replace('\\', "\\\\").replace('%', "\\%").replace('_', "\\_"))
}

type Pairs = Vec<(String, Option<String>)>;

/// Puts each filter value in place of any value the caller gave for that column.
fn scoped(mut pairs: Pairs, filter: &[(&str, &str)]) -> Pairs {
    for &(k, v) in filter {
        pairs.retain(|(c, _)| c != k);
        pairs.push((k.to_owned(), Some(v.to_owned())));
    }
    pairs
}

pub struct Table {
    pub name: &'static str,
    pub key: &'static str,
    pub order: &'static str,
    pub types: &'static [(&'static str, &'static str)],
    pub writable: &'static [&'static str],
}

impl Table {
    fn ty(&self, col: &str) -> &'static str {
        self.types.iter().find(|(c, _)| *c == col).map(|(_, t)| *t).unwrap_or("text")
    }

    fn has(&self, col: &str) -> bool {
        self.types.iter().any(|(c, _)| *c == col)
    }

    fn cast(&self, col: &str, n: usize) -> String {
        format!("${n}::text::{}", self.ty(col))
    }

    fn where_sql(&self, pairs: &Pairs, args: &mut Vec<Option<String>>) -> String {
        let mut parts = Vec::new();
        for (k, v) in pairs {
            args.push(v.clone());
            parts.push(format!("{} = {}", quote(k), self.cast(k, args.len())));
        }
        parts.join(" AND ")
    }

    fn with_key(&self, id: &str, filter: &[(&str, &str)]) -> Pairs {
        scoped(vec![(self.key.to_owned(), Some(id.to_owned()))], filter)
    }

    fn pick(&self, body: &str) -> Pairs {
        let mut row = Pairs::new();
        if let Ok(Value::Object(fields)) = serde_json::from_str::<Value>(body) {
            for (k, v) in &fields {
                let c = snake(k);
                if c != self.key && self.writable.contains(&c.as_str()) {
                    row.push((c, text(v)));
                }
            }
        }
        row
    }

    async fn one(status: u16, sql: String, args: Vec<Option<String>>) -> Reply {
        let client = match pool().get().await {
            Ok(c) => c,
            Err(e) => {
                tracing::warn!(error = %e, "no database connection");
                return error(503, json!({ "error": "unavailable" }));
            }
        };
        let params: Vec<&(dyn ToSql + Sync)> = args.iter().map(|a| a as &(dyn ToSql + Sync)).collect();
        match client.query_opt(&sql, &params).await {
            Ok(Some(row)) => match row.get::<_, Option<String>>(0) {
                Some(json) => Reply { status, body: Some(json) },
                None => not_found(),
            },
            Ok(None) => not_found(),
            Err(e) => rejected(e),
        }
    }

    /// ?q= searches text columns, ?column= filters, ?sort=column or -column orders, ?page= or ?offset= with ?limit= pages.
    pub async fn list(&self, query: &HashMap<String, String>, filter: &[(&str, &str)]) -> Reply {
        let num = |k: &str, d: i64| query.get(k).and_then(|v| v.trim().parse::<i64>().ok()).unwrap_or(d);
        let limit = num("limit", 50).clamp(1, 500);
        let offset = if query.contains_key("offset") { num("offset", 0).max(0) } else { (num("page", 1).max(1) - 1) * limit };
        let mut matched: Pairs = query
            .iter()
            .filter(|(k, v)| self.has(k) && !RESERVED.contains(&k.as_str()) && !v.is_empty())
            .map(|(k, v)| (k.clone(), Some(v.clone())))
            .collect();
        matched.sort();
        let matched = scoped(matched, filter);
        let mut args = Vec::new();
        let mut where_sql = self.where_sql(&matched, &mut args);
        let search = query.get("q").map(|s| s.trim()).unwrap_or("");
        let mut cols: Vec<&str> = self.types.iter().filter(|(_, t)| text_type(t)).map(|(c, _)| *c).collect();
        cols.sort();
        if !search.is_empty() && !cols.is_empty() {
            let mut ors = Vec::new();
            for c in cols {
                args.push(Some(like(search)));
                ors.push(format!("{} ILIKE ${}", quote(c), args.len()));
            }
            let clause = format!("({})", ors.join(" OR "));
            where_sql = if where_sql.is_empty() { clause } else { format!("{where_sql} AND {clause}") };
        }
        let sort = query.get("sort").map(String::as_str).unwrap_or("");
        let col = sort.trim_start_matches('-');
        let sort_by = if self.has(col) { format!("{} {}, {}", quote(col), if sort.starts_with('-') { "DESC" } else { "ASC" }, self.order) } else { self.order.to_owned() };
        let filtered = if where_sql.is_empty() { String::new() } else { format!(" WHERE {where_sql}") };
        Self::one(200, format!("SELECT coalesce(json_agg(r), '[]'::json)::text FROM (SELECT * FROM {}{filtered} ORDER BY {sort_by} LIMIT {limit} OFFSET {offset}) r", quote(self.name)), args).await
    }

    pub async fn get(&self, id: &str, filter: &[(&str, &str)]) -> Reply {
        let mut args = Vec::new();
        let where_sql = self.where_sql(&self.with_key(id, filter), &mut args);
        Self::one(200, format!("SELECT row_to_json(r)::text FROM {} r WHERE {where_sql}", quote(self.name)), args).await
    }

    pub async fn create(&self, body: &str, fixed: &[(&str, &str)]) -> Reply {
        let row = scoped(self.pick(body), fixed);
        if row.is_empty() {
            return Self::one(201, format!("WITH r AS (INSERT INTO {} DEFAULT VALUES RETURNING *) SELECT row_to_json(r)::text FROM r", quote(self.name)), vec![]).await;
        }
        let names: Vec<String> = row.iter().map(|(c, _)| quote(c)).collect();
        let params: Vec<String> = row.iter().enumerate().map(|(i, (c, _))| self.cast(c, i + 1)).collect();
        let args = row.into_iter().map(|(_, v)| v).collect();
        Self::one(201, format!("WITH r AS (INSERT INTO {} ({}) VALUES ({}) RETURNING *) SELECT row_to_json(r)::text FROM r", quote(self.name), names.join(", "), params.join(", ")), args).await
    }

    pub async fn update(&self, id: &str, body: &str, filter: &[(&str, &str)]) -> Reply {
        let mut row = self.pick(body);
        // The parent and owner the route scopes to cannot be moved by the caller.
        row.retain(|(c, _)| !filter.iter().any(|(k, _)| k == c));
        if row.is_empty() {
            return error(400, json!({ "error": "invalid", "detail": format!("nothing to update; writable fields are {}", self.writable.join(", ")) }));
        }
        let sets: Vec<String> = row.iter().enumerate().map(|(i, (c, _))| format!("{} = {}", quote(c), self.cast(c, i + 1))).collect();
        let mut args: Vec<Option<String>> = row.into_iter().map(|(_, v)| v).collect();
        let where_sql = self.where_sql(&self.with_key(id, filter), &mut args);
        Self::one(200, format!("WITH r AS (UPDATE {} SET {} WHERE {where_sql} RETURNING *) SELECT row_to_json(r)::text FROM r", quote(self.name), sets.join(", ")), args).await
    }

    pub async fn remove(&self, id: &str, filter: &[(&str, &str)]) -> Reply {
        let mut args = Vec::new();
        let where_sql = self.where_sql(&self.with_key(id, filter), &mut args);
        let client = match pool().get().await {
            Ok(c) => c,
            Err(e) => {
                tracing::warn!(error = %e, "no database connection");
                return error(503, json!({ "error": "unavailable" }));
            }
        };
        let params: Vec<&(dyn ToSql + Sync)> = args.iter().map(|a| a as &(dyn ToSql + Sync)).collect();
        match client.execute(&format!("DELETE FROM {} WHERE {where_sql}", quote(self.name)), &params).await {
            Ok(0) => not_found(),
            Ok(_) => Reply { status: 204, body: None },
            Err(e) => rejected(e),
        }
    }
}
